newsitem.title: USA: Christopher sending envoy Ross to Middle East.
newsitem.headline: Christopher sending envoy Ross to Middle East.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher, voicing concern over "the recent drift" in the Middle East peace process, on Thursday said special envoy Dennis Ross would go to the region at the weekend.

"The president and I have been concerned about the recent drift in the peace process," Christopher told reporters at a year-end news conference. "To re-energize this effort we are sending (U.S. special Middle East envoy) Dennis Ross to the region this weekend."
Christopher said Ross would "report on the status of negotiations there" and would return before Christmas "so that we can have an up-to-date assessment."

Both Christopher and President Bill Clinton have voiced frustration this week with the slow pace of negotiations over the pullout of Israeli troops from the West Bank town of Hebron and over Israel's policy on settlements in the West Bank.

Israel and the Palestinian Authority renewed talks on Monday. Hebron is the last of seven West Bank towns from which Israeli troops are supposed to redeploy under previous accords, but the talks are bogged down over security arrangements for Hebron's 400 Jews.
